roots.origin: 拉丁语 aestimare（估价、定出值多少）；经古法语 estimer 一路出 estimate（把量算出来），另一路出 esteem（把人的分量看高），二者是同源双式；古法语 aesmer 又出 aim
roots.core_concept: to set a value on a thing / 给一样东西定出分量
roots.core_image: 东西拿在手里颠一颠，心里给它标上一个数
roots.english_definition: to value, appraise, reckon the worth of

roots.origin: 拉丁语 emere（取、拿，后转指买），过去分词 emptus；eximere（ex-＋emere 取出去）派出 exempt 与 exemplum（取出来作样子的那一个），后者经古法语出 example 与 sample。库中 sumere（sub-＋emere）按拉丁动词各自立根，与本根另有分立
roots.core_concept: to take a thing out of the lot / 从一堆里把一样取出来
roots.core_image: 手伸进一堆东西里，捏住一样抽出来，剩下的还在原处

concepts.concept: to set a value on a thing
concepts.core_image: 东西拿在手里颠一颠，心里给它标上一个数

concepts.concept: to take a thing out of the lot
concepts.core_image: 手伸进一堆东西里，捏住一样抽出来，剩下的还在原处

words.origin: 古法语 empire ← 拉丁语 imperium（号令之权）← imperare（下令、统辖）：in-（向）+ parare（备置）；承义的是下令统辖这一支，不是备置，故未挂 parare，与库中 emperor 同一处理
words.native_definition: a large group of territories or peoples ruled by a single supreme authority
words.core_concept: many lands answering to one voice – 许多地方听同一个声音发号令
words.core_image: 一张地图上十几块颜色不同的地界，箭头全指向中间那一座城
examples: The empire stretched from the sea to the mountains.
She built a publishing empire from one shop.
semantic_expansions: 帝国：许多地方被一个至高权力收在一起，令出一处
帝位：坐在那个至高位置上的身份
大企业集团：一人或一家把一大摊生意攥在手里，结构与前者同理
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: en-（in- 在里头）+ gine（gen 生）+ -eer（做这行的人）→ 天生的那份巧思，做成器械，造器械的就是这行人
words.origin: 古法语 engigneor ← 晚期拉丁语 ingeniare ← 拉丁语 ingenium（天生的才具、巧思）：in-（在里头）+ gignere（生）；ingenium 到晚期拉丁语才转指攻城器械，engine 由此
words.native_definition: a person trained to design, build, or maintain machines and structures
words.core_concept: the inborn knack turned into built things – 生在里头的巧思做成实物
words.core_image: 图纸上几根线，最后变成一根压得住卡车的钢梁架在河上
examples: The engineer checked every bolt on the bridge.
They engineered the whole deal in one week.
semantic_expansions: 工程师：把图纸上的东西真造出来的那个人
技师：管着机器、让它一直转得动的人
策划：像装机器一样把事一环环安排上，用在人事上带贬义

words.root_logic: ex-（彻底）+ agger（土堆，出自 aggerere：ad-＋gerere 搬到一处）+ -ate → 一趟趟往上堆，堆得比实有的高
words.origin: 拉丁语 exaggeratus ← exaggerare（堆高、放大）：ex-（彻底）+ aggerare（堆积）← agger（土堆）← aggerere（ad-＋gerere 搬拢来）；英语先有「堆起来」义，1560 年代才转指说过头
words.native_definition: to represent something as larger or more extreme than it really is
words.core_concept: piling it higher than what is really there – 堆得比实有的高
words.core_image: 一筐土倒上去还嫌矮，又添两筐，堆头比原来那个坑挖出的土多出一半
examples: He tends to exaggerate the size of his catch.
Do not exaggerate the danger of the trip.
semantic_expansions: 夸大：把事情的分量往上添，添到超出实情
夸张：为了效果故意加码，听的人也知道有水分
言过其实：说出来的比实际撑得住的多

words.origin: 拉丁语 foederatio ← foederare（结盟）← foedus（属格 foederis：盟约）；foedus 与 fides（信任）虽同追到印欧语 *bheidh-，在拉丁已分化为两词，不同源，故不挂 fidere；与 ex＋dare（交出）一支也无关
words.native_definition: a union of states or organizations that keep some powers of their own
words.core_concept: separate parties bound by one covenant – 各方被同一份约绑到一起
words.core_image: 几家各自盖了章，章盖在同一张纸上，往后对外只认这一张
examples: The federation includes twelve independent states.
A new federation of unions was formed.
semantic_expansions: 联邦：各邦留着自己的权，对外却当一个整体行动
联合会：同类团体立约合成的一个组织
结盟：立约把彼此绑上的那个动作
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: fert（ferre 带出、生养）+ -ile（能够）→ 能一茬茬把东西生出来的
words.origin: 拉丁语 fertilis（多产的）← ferre（带、生养）；注意与拉丁语 ferire（击打）不同源，拼写相近而已
words.native_definition: able to produce a lot of crops, young, or ideas
words.core_concept: able to bring forth crop after crop – 能一茬接一茬地生出东西
words.core_image: 土捏在手里松散发黑，种子撒下去第五天就顶出一排绿芽
examples: The valley has deep fertile soil.
She went through a fertile period of writing.
semantic_expansions: 肥沃的：地力足，种什么都出得好
多产的：一茬接一茬地出，产量高
富于创造力的：脑子里点子一个接一个冒出来，与地里出产同理

words.origin: 希腊语 energetikos（能干活的）← energeia（在动的力）：en-（在内）+ ergon（活儿）；本项目未为 ergon 一支建根，该族在词表内只有 energy 一词相伴
words.native_definition: having or showing a lot of physical or mental force
words.core_concept: force at work inside, showing on the outside – 里头有劲在动，外头看得出来
words.core_image: 早上六点跑完一圈回来，进门还能一口气把桌子搬到墙边
examples: The energetic child never sat still.
She gave an energetic speech to the crowd.
semantic_expansions: 精力充沛的：身上力气用不完，做完一件还想做下一件
积极的：做事时劲头明显，肯往前顶
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 engagier（押上、许下）：en-＋gage（抵押物）← 法兰克语 *wadi（保证物），日耳曼源；与库中 engage 同一处理
words.native_definition: a formal promise or arrangement, or a period of active involvement
words.core_concept: a pledge laid down that cannot be pulled back – 押下去就抽不回的那句话
words.core_image: 戒指套上手指，日子写进本子，两边都知道这话收不回来了
examples: They announced their engagement last spring.
He had an engagement at three that day.
semantic_expansions: 订婚：把婚约先押下，众人都知道
约定：定好的那一次会面或安排
交战：两支队伍咬上了，抽不开身
参与：把自己投进去，不是站在旁边看
words.decomposable_note: 源头在日耳曼语支，经法语回流入英语，本项目未为其词族建根

words.origin: 法语 enthousiasme ← 希腊语 enthousiasmos（神灵附身的激动）← entheos：en-（在内）+ theos（神）；本项目未为 theos 一支建根。英语 theory 出希腊语 theorein（观看），与 theos 不同源
words.native_definition: a strong feeling of excitement and eagerness about something
words.core_concept: a larger force moving in you from inside – 身体里像住进一股更大的劲头
words.core_image: 一说起这件事眼睛就亮，手上比划起来，椅子都坐不住
examples: She spoke about the plan with great enthusiasm.
His enthusiasm for cooking never faded.
semantic_expansions: 热情：整个人为某事烧起来
热忱：这股劲一直朝一个方向使，不是一时冲动
极大兴趣：被某样东西攫住，一说起来就停不下
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 法语 environnement ← environner（围住）← environ（在周围）：en-（在内）+ viron（一圈）← virer（转）；virer 更早词源不明
words.native_definition: the surroundings and conditions in which a person or thing exists
words.core_concept: the full circle of what stands around you – 绕着你转一圈所见的全部
words.core_image: 站在原地转一圈，看见的树、墙、路面和空气里的味道全算在里头
examples: Children need a safe environment to grow in.
We must protect the environment from waste.
semantic_expansions: 环境：人或物身处其中的那一圈条件
自然环境：这一圈里属于山水草木空气的那部分
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 erroneus（走岔的）← errare（走岔、游荡）；本项目未为 errare 一支建根，该族在词表内只有 error 相伴，与库中 error 同一处理
words.native_definition: based on a mistake and therefore not correct
words.core_concept: having wandered off the right road – 从对的那条路上岔开了
words.core_image: 照着记下的门牌号找过去，站在门口才发现整条街都走岔了
examples: The report was based on erroneous data.
He drew an erroneous conclusion from one case.
semantic_expansions: 错误的：结论或说法本身岔了，站不住
不正确的：与事实对不上，需要改过来
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: es-（ex- 出来）+ cort（corrigere ← regere 引直、带正）→ 一路把人引着走、护着走的那个
words.origin: 法语 escorte ← 意大利语 scorta（引路）← scorgere（引导）← 通俗拉丁语 *excorrigere：ex-（出来）+ corrigere（com-＋regere 引直）；承义的是引导这一支，与库中 regula（木尺、准绳）那一支不同支
words.native_definition: a person or vehicle that accompanies another to protect or guide it
words.core_concept: one who leads another straight through – 一路引着别人走过去的那个
words.core_image: 两辆车一前一后夹着中间那辆，路口先停下来看一眼才让它过
examples: Two police cars escorted the truck to the border.
She arrived under a heavy escort.
semantic_expansions: 护送：一路跟着把人或物带到地方，防着出事
护送队：干这件事的那一队人马
陪同：出于礼数陪着走一段，不为安全

words.root_logic: estimat（aestimare 估价、定出值多少）+ -e → 不上秤先给它定一个数
words.origin: 拉丁语 aestimatus ← aestimare（估价、定值）；经古法语 estimer 入英语，与 esteem 同源双式
words.native_definition: to judge roughly the size, value, or cost of something
words.core_concept: putting a number on a thing without measuring it – 不量就给它标一个数
words.core_image: 手按在木箱上往上提半寸就放下，嘴里报出一个数，没上秤
examples: He estimated the crowd at two thousand people.
The builder gave us an estimate on Friday.
semantic_expansions: 估计：不精确的量，凭经验说个大概
估算：拿数字往下算一个近似结果
报价：把要花多少钱先定出来写给对方

words.origin: 拉丁语 evaporatus ← evaporare：ex-（出去）+ vapor（水汽）；本项目未为 vapor 一支建根，该族在词表内只此一词
words.native_definition: to change from a liquid into a gas, or to fade away gradually
words.core_concept: going off into the air until nothing is left – 化成气跑掉，原处什么也不剩
words.core_image: 一滴水落在烧热的铁板上，边缘往里缩，几秒后那块印子也没了
examples: The puddle evaporated within an hour.
His confidence evaporated before the interview.
semantic_expansions: 蒸发：液体变成气跑掉
消失：本来有的东西一点点没了，与前者同一个走法
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ ampl（exemplum ← eximere：ex-＋emere 取出去）→ 从一堆里取出来给人看的那一个
words.origin: 古法语 example ← 拉丁语 exemplum（取出来作样子的那一个）← eximere（取出去）：ex-＋emere（取）；与 exempt、sample 同出一源
words.native_definition: a thing taken from a group to show what the rest are like
words.core_concept: one taken out of the lot to stand for all – 从一堆里取一个出来代表全体
words.core_image: 从一筐橘子里拿出一个剥开，说整筐都是这个甜度
examples: She gave three examples to make her point.
He set a good example for the team.
semantic_expansions: 例子：拿出来说明道理的那一个
榜样：拿出来给人照着做的那一个
实例：真发生过、可以指着说的那一件

words.origin: 拉丁语 excerptus ← excerpere（摘出来）：ex-（出来）+ carpere（摘、拉扯）；本项目未为 carpere 一支建根，与库中 carpet 同一处理
words.native_definition: a short passage taken from a longer text or piece of music
words.core_concept: a piece plucked out of a longer whole – 从整篇里摘下来的一小块
words.core_image: 整本书里划出半页抄到另一张纸上，前后都断着
examples: The paper printed an excerpt from her diary.
He excerpted two pages for the class.
semantic_expansions: 摘录：从长文里摘下来的那一段
节选：为某个用途挑出来的一部分，前后不全
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: ex-（出去）+ empt（emere 取，过去分词 emptus）→ 被从名单里取出去，那条规矩管不着他
words.origin: 拉丁语 exemptus ← eximere（取出去、免除）：ex-＋emere（取）；与 example 同出一源
words.native_definition: not required to do or pay something that others must
words.core_concept: taken out from what binds the rest – 从管着别人的那条规矩里取出去
words.core_image: 名单上一排人都得交，他那一行被划出来，笔尖跳过去接着往下走
examples: Small farms are exempt from the new tax.
The rule exempts children under six.
semantic_expansions: 免除的：不必照办、不必缴的那种身份
豁免：把某人从义务里取出去这个动作

words.origin: 古法语 espaundre ← 拉丁语 expandere（摊开）：ex-（出去）+ pandere（张开、铺开）；本项目未为 pandere 一支建根，该族在词表内只有 expansion 相伴
words.native_definition: to become larger, or to make something larger or fuller
words.core_concept: a folded thing opened out to take more room – 折着的东西摊开，占的地方变多
words.core_image: 折成八折的地图两手往两边一拉，桌面被它占满，边角垂到地上
examples: Metal expands when it is heated.
The company plans to expand into Asia.
semantic_expansions: 膨胀：本体自己往外长大
扩大：把范围或规模往外推
详述：把说得简略的地方一条条铺开讲全
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 extravagans（走出界外的）：extra-（越出）+ vagari（游荡）；本项目未为 vagari 一支建根，该族在词表内只此一词
words.native_definition: spending or costing much more than is necessary or reasonable
words.core_concept: wandering out past where the line was drawn – 越过该有的界线往外走
words.core_image: 八个人点了十六道菜，最后剩下大半原样端走，还添了两瓶没开的酒
examples: He was extravagant with money after the win.
They held an extravagant wedding by the lake.
semantic_expansions: 挥霍的：钱流出去没个数
奢华的：用的东西远超需要的档次
过分的：言行超出常理该有的度
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 faint（装的、装死的）← feindre ← 拉丁语 fingere（捏塑、假造）；本项目未为 fingere 一支建根，该族在词表内只有 fiction 相伴
words.native_definition: very weak, unclear, or to lose consciousness briefly
words.core_concept: so weak it can barely hold – 弱到几乎撑不住
words.core_image: 远处一声铃，得屏住呼吸才听得出；那人脸色发白，膝一软往下滑
examples: There was a faint smell of smoke.
She fainted in the crowded hall.
semantic_expansions: 微弱的：声音、光线弱到几乎抓不住
昏倒：人撑不住了，一下失去知觉
模糊的：轮廓淡得看不清，与前者同一个弱法
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: phan（phainein 使显现）+ -tastic → 只在心里现出来的那个影，因而离奇，后转指好得不像真的
words.origin: 古法语 fantastique ← 晚期拉丁语 phantasticus ← 希腊语 phantastikos（能想象的）← phantazein（使显现）← phainein（使显现）；与库中 fantasy、fancy 同出此支
words.native_definition: extremely good, or strange and hard to believe
words.core_concept: showing only in the mind, not outside – 只在心里现出来，外头并没有
words.core_image: 闭上眼就看见会飞的鱼和倒着长的树，睁眼一看窗外什么都没有
examples: The food at that place was fantastic.
He told a fantastic story about a talking dog.
semantic_expansions: 极好的：好到不像真的，日常用得最多
离奇的：离常理太远，听着像编的
幻想的：只存在于想象里的

words.origin: 古法语 festival ← 拉丁语 festivalis ← festivus ← festum（节庆的日子）；本项目未为 festum 一支建根，与库中 feast 同一处理
words.native_definition: a day or period of celebration, often with music and public events
words.core_concept: a day set apart when ordinary work stops – 定下来的那一天，平日的活都停下
words.core_image: 街口挂起一长串彩旗，店铺都关了门，人比平日多出三倍
examples: The village holds a music festival each June.
Shops close during the spring festival.
semantic_expansions: 节日：定期到来、大家一起过的那一天
节庆：那几天里的热闹场面
艺术节：为某一门类专设的一段集中活动
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: em-（en- 在内）+ phas（phainein 显现）+ -ize → 把某一处特意显出来给人看见
words.origin: 英语 emphasis（← 希腊语 emphasis：en-＋phainein 使显现）加 -ize 构成，与库中 emphasis 同根
words.native_definition: to give special importance to something in speech or writing
words.core_concept: making one part stand out into view – 让其中一处特意露出来
words.core_image: 念到那句话时放慢下来，手指在纸上那一行底下重划一道
examples: She emphasized the need for more time.
He emphasized every word of the warning.
semantic_expansions: 强调：把某一点说重，让人别漏掉
着重：分配力气时偏向这一处

words.root_logic: en-（in- 在里头）+ gine（gen 生）+ -eering → 把天生的巧思用成一门造器械的手艺
words.origin: 英语 engineer 加 -ing 构成 ← 拉丁语 ingenium（天生的才具）：in-（在里头）+ gignere（生）
words.native_definition: the work of designing and building machines, structures, and systems
words.core_concept: the craft of making the inborn knack into structures – 把巧思做成实物的那门手艺
words.core_image: 一张剖面图旁边压着计算纸，纸上每根梁承多少重都写着数
examples: He studied engineering at a small college.
The tunnel was a feat of engineering.
semantic_expansions: 工程：按图把大件东西造起来的整件事
工程学：研究怎么造的那门学问
工程技术：真动手时用的那套办法

words.root_logic: e-（ex- 出来）+ scal（scala 梯子 ← scandere 攀登）+ -ate → 一级级往上爬，只上不下
words.origin: 由 escalator（1900 年 Otis 公司商名，取自 escalade）反推而成 ← 法语 escalade ← 意大利语 scalata ← scala（梯子）；scala 与拉丁语 scandere（攀登）相关，与库中 scale 同支
words.native_definition: to become or make something more serious or intense step by step
words.core_concept: climbing rung by rung with no step back – 一级级往上，没有退回那一步
words.core_image: 先是拍桌子，接着摔杯子，第三天两家门口各站了七八个人
examples: The quarrel escalated into a street fight.
Costs escalated after the delay.
semantic_expansions: 升级：事态往更严重的一级去
逐步加剧：一点点加重，不是一下爆开
上涨：数目一级级往上走

words.root_logic: esteem（aestimare 估价、定分量）→ 把这个人的分量估得高
words.origin: 古法语 estimer ← 拉丁语 aestimare（估价）；十六世纪起专指把人看高，与 estimate 同源双式
words.native_definition: respect and admiration for someone, or to regard someone highly
words.core_concept: reckoning a person's worth as high – 把这个人的分量估到高处
words.core_image: 他一进屋，屋里几个人都站起来，把靠里的位子腾给他
examples: She is held in high esteem by her students.
We esteem him for his honesty.
semantic_expansions: 尊重：把对方的分量摆在自己之上
敬重：不光认他的分量，还仰着头看
看重：认定他有分量，愿意为他费力

words.origin: 中古英语 every body 的合成：every（← 古英语 æfre ǣlc 每一个）+ body（← 古英语 bodig 躯干），日耳曼复合词，与库中 nobody 同一构法
words.native_definition: every person in a group, with no one left out
words.core_concept: every single one counted in – 一个一个数过来，谁也不落下
words.core_image: 点名单点到最后一行，每个名字后面都画了勾，没有空着的
examples: Everybody in the room stood up at once.
Everybody knows the shop closes at six.
semantic_expansions: 每个人：逐个算，一个不漏
人人：不必逐个点，泛指所有人
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 every where 的合成：every（← 古英语 æfre ǣlc）+ where（← 古英语 hwǣr 何处），日耳曼复合词，与库中 anywhere 同一构法
words.native_definition: in or to all places
words.core_concept: in each place, none skipped – 每一处都算上，没有跳过的
words.core_image: 同一张海报贴在车站的柱子上、闸机旁、电梯里，抬头就撞见一张
examples: There was dust everywhere in the old house.
She looked everywhere for her keys.
semantic_expansions: 处处：着眼于每一个地方都有
到处：着眼于走动之中处处碰见
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ cit（citare 唤起、催动）+ -ing → 把原本静着的那股劲唤起来，让人坐不住
words.origin: 英语 excite（← 拉丁语 excitare：ex-＋citare 唤起）加 -ing 构成，与库中 excite、excitement 同根
words.native_definition: causing strong interest and a lively happy feeling
words.core_concept: rousing a force that was lying still – 把本来不动的那股劲唤起来
words.core_image: 比分追平那一刻，看台上前排的人全站起来，手里的杯子都忘了
examples: The last ten minutes were really exciting.
They planned an exciting trip to the coast.
semantic_expansions: 令人兴奋的：让人心跳加快、想动起来
刺激的：那股劲来得猛，带点冒险味道

words.origin: 中古英语 ferther，是 further 的变体，受 far 的词形牵引而成 ← 古英语 furðor（更向前）← 原始日耳曼语 *furþera-；与库中 further 同源
words.native_definition: at or to a greater distance
words.core_concept: more forward along the same line – 顺着同一条线更往前一段
words.core_image: 同一条路上，从这块路牌走到下一块，回头看车已经缩成一个点
examples: We walked farther than we had planned.
The farther bank was hidden by fog.
semantic_expansions: 更远地：作副词，走得比原先更远
更远的：作形容词，两者之中离得远的那一个
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: fert（ferre 带出、生养）+ -ilize（使能够）+ -er（那样东西）→ 撒下去让地能多生出东西的那样东西
words.origin: 英语 fertile（← 拉丁语 fertilis ← ferre 带、生养）加 -ize、-er 构成，与库中 transfer、offer 同根
words.native_definition: a substance added to soil to help plants grow better
words.core_concept: what is put in so the ground brings forth more – 添进地里让它多生出东西的那样东西
words.core_image: 一把灰白颗粒顺着犁沟撒下去，两周后那一行苗比旁边高出半个手掌
examples: The farmer spread fertilizer over the field.
Too much fertilizer can harm the soil.
semantic_expansions: 肥料：添进土里帮着长的东西，可以是天然的
化肥：工厂做出来的那种，成分是配好的

words.origin: 古英语 fyllan（使满）← 原始日耳曼语 *fullijan ← *fullaz（满的）；与库中 full 同源。拉丁语 plere（填满）虽同追到印欧语 *pele-，两支在各自语言内早已分开，本项目另有 plere 根，不合并
words.native_definition: to make something full, or to become full
words.core_concept: adding until no more will go in – 一直添到再添不进去
words.core_image: 水从龙头下来，桶里的水面一点点往上走，最后齐到桶口那道边
examples: She filled the glass with cold water.
Smoke filled the whole kitchen in seconds.
semantic_expansions: 填满：把缺口、空隙补上，不留空
装满：往容器里放到齐口
占满：人或物把整个空间挤住，不剩地方
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
